summary: Douglas County site on the Oregon lookout list: set up while in Umpqua NF, later under state (ODF) control after a land adjustment; no dates, type or status found.

events.note: The list says a lookout was established on the site while the section was part of the Umpqua National Forest. No year is given.
After a land adjustment the site came under state control (Oregon Department of Forestry). No year is given.

corrections.why: The list gives Umpqua National Forest as the agency while the section was in the forest, then says control passed to the state after a land adjustment.
The same list entry says that after a land adjustment the site fell under state control.

notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this Douglas County site: the Oregon list entry, which gives the section, the agency chain and the county, and says the establishment and removal dates and the structure type are not available. Status, access and staffing are unknown, and the story says so only where the list speaks. Two web searches and a check of the NHLR and firelookout.org Oregon lists found no other Douglas County Buckhorn lookout. The Buckhorn lookouts they surfaced are in Wallowa County (NHLR US 1609, OR 136, cited only for the cross-reference) and in Washington. The brief's agency and ownership are the proposed corrections. Whether anything stands at the site today is unknown; ODF or Umpqua NF records would settle it. An existing story file us-or-buckhorn-mountain (different id) was not read or changed.
